# ClickCraft - Performance Marketing & Growth Consultancy

> Data-driven performance marketing agency scaling B2B SaaS, E-commerce, and high-growth brands.

## About
ClickCraft is a performance marketing and growth consultancy that helps brands scale through data-driven strategies, paid media optimization, and conversion rate improvements. We specialize in turning marketing spend into measurable revenue.

## Services
- Performance Marketing (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads)
- Growth Strategy Consultation
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
- SEO & Content Strategy
- Analytics & Reporting Dashboards
- Funnel Analysis & Optimization
